title: Destination C1&C2 · Unit 14 · I · Phrases, patterns and collocations · tr.116–117

parts.name: I · Phrases, patterns and collocations · tr.116–117
parts.instructions: Write one word in each gap.

items.stem: Jane just stood there and watched while we did all the work. A ____ lot of use that was!
items.explanation_vi: 'A fat lot of use' là chẳng có ích gì (nói mỉa).

items.stem: You can make a lot of money if you work in ____ finance.
items.explanation_vi: 'High finance' là tài chính quy mô lớn.

items.stem: We've travelled the length and ____ of the country looking for the next Teen Star!
items.explanation_vi: 'The length and breadth of' là khắp nơi.
'Long time no see' là lâu quá không gặp.

items.stem: The first moments of the universe are often known as the Big ____.
items.explanation_vi: 'The Big Bang' là vụ nổ lớn.

items.stem: It only cost five euros and we were there all day. We really did get our money's ____.
items.explanation_vi: 'Get your money's worth' là đáng đồng tiền.

items.stem: It's a pay and ____ car park, so get a ticket from the machine before you go shopping.
items.explanation_vi: 'Pay and display' là trả tiền rồi dán vé lên kính.

items.stem: 'That was very generous of you to give half of your lunch to Tony.' 'Share and share ____, that's what I say.'
items.explanation_vi: 'Share and share alike' là chia đều cho nhau.

items.stem: And suddenly Diana appeared out of ____ air.
items.explanation_vi: 'Out of thin air' là bỗng nhiên xuất hiện.

items.stem: I think you're on very weak ____ with that argument.
items.explanation_vi: 'On weak ground' là lập luận yếu.
